sloka: परिणीय च सर्वत्र नीतो अहम् राम सम्सदम् ।रुधिर आदिग्ध सर्व अन्गो विह्वलः चलित इन्द्रियः ॥६-३०-९॥।।
transliteration: pariṇīya ca sarvatra nīto aham rāma samsadam ।rudhira ādigdha sarva ango vihvalaḥ calita indriyaḥ ॥6-30-9॥।।

translations.english: "With all my limbs wet with bleeding, control over senses lost, after parading, I was led to the assembly of Rama."
